rules.mapping: One subscriber, optional spouse, and relationship=child dependents under 26. One adult alone: single; two adults alone: couple; one adult with children: adult_children; two adults with children: family. Child-only policies and dependent extensions require separate evidence and are unsupported here.
rules.citation: NY Insurance Law 3231(a), 4317(a); 11 NYCRR Part 360 (Regulation 145), 360.2(b). NY DFS PY2026 filing instructions (2025-04-20), sections M-N, pp.16-17: standardized tiers. DFS individual comprehensive checklist (2024-07-11), dependent coverage: parent/child and family contracts cover children until 26.

rules.mapping: DVHA PY2026 issuer guidance section 2.2: single person, couple, adult and dependents, family (two adults and dependents). Relationship=child under 26 is the supported subset. Age-26 end-of-year coverage, disabled dependent extensions, child-only policies and other relationships require separate evidence. Do not use the dental tiers in section 3.2.1 for medical plans.
rules.citation: 33 V.S.A. 1811(e)-(f) governs exchange health benefit plans; DFR Docket 13-002-I (2013-03-13), p.2, mandates tiers and multipliers for 2014 and thereafter. DVHA Issuer Guidance for Participation 2026 (updated October 2025), section 2.2 p.11 and 2.3 p.11; VHC Student FAQ confirms dependent coverage until 26 with possible calendar-year extension. 8 V.S.A. 4080a concerns small groups; it is not the individual exchange tier order.
